# upsnap_groups (Data Source)

List device groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "upsnap_groups" "all" {}

output "group_names" {
  value = data.upsnap_groups.all.groups[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only groups with exactly this name.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Matching groups, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Record ID.
- `name` (String) Group name.
